name: Bipartisanship Has a (Calendar) Season
claim: Congressional bipartisan-signaling language ("bipartisan", "across the aisle") dips every August–October and rebounds every November–January — but it troughs just as reliably in non-election years (7 of 7) as in election years (6 of 6), so the rhythm tracks the fall recess-and-campaign calendar, not the ballot. It's a season, not a strategy.

numbers.election_cycle_troughs: 6/6 election cycles show the Aug–Oct trough / Nov–Jan rebound
numbers.placebo_troughs: 7/7 non-election (odd) years show the same trough in the same window
numbers.original_confirm_gate: trough inside 90 days of the election, rebound after, in both odd/even splits
numbers.what_overturned_it: placebo (fake Nov-4 elections in odd/non-election years) troughs 7/7, matching the election-year 6/6

confounds_tested: electoral timing vs seasonal calendar -> PLACEBO KILL: fake Nov-4 elections in odd/non-election years, same Aug-Oct window, trough 7/7 -> the 6/6 election-year troughs are fully explained by season, not the ballot
recess + campaign-season fall vs winter-legislating -> the surviving mechanism (seasonal), not electoral strategy
split_result: election cycles: trough in 6/6; placebo (odd/non-election years, same windows): trough in 7/7. The placebo matching the treatment collapses the electoral reading and leaves the seasonal one.
chart_spec: weekly bipartisan-signal rate over the calendar year, election-year cycles overlaid on non-election (placebo) years; both curves show the same Aug–Oct trough and Nov–Jan rebound. Annotate 6/6 (election) vs 7/7 (placebo) trough tallies.
receipts_note: receipts = specific member statements containing "bipartisan"/"across the aisle" in trough (Aug–Oct) vs rebound (Nov–Jan) months from the phrase/statement index, expandable to member + date + url; pull at publish time
republication_note: REVERSAL: the original electoral hypothesis is dead; the finding must be re-pre-registered in the found direction (bipartisan language has an autumn-vs-winter seasonal rhythm, recess/campaign vs winter-legislating) before publishing.
graveyard_context: The marquee integrity catch of Wave S1: a clean 6/6 CONFIRM ('bipartisanship flees elections') was caught and reversed by the built-in placebo (§4.5 adversarial pass) before it shipped. The single best demonstration of why the discipline exists.
